Remote wake settings
Reading network adapter settings…
Connect to this paired computer first, then open Remote wake settings.
Wake settings are unavailable. Check that the computer is online and has an updated ClipRelay host.
No physical network adapter was detected.
Choose the adapter connected to the target LAN
Wake settings enabled; untested
Wake settings disabled
Adapter reports no magic-packet support
Capability needs confirmation
Disconnected
Connect this adapter to the target LAN before saving its wake settings.

Check the adapter’s Wake on Magic Packet and permission to wake the computer in Windows Device Manager. BIOS/UEFI, the driver and sleep or shutdown mode also affect wake support. After adjusting the settings, refresh this page. ClipRelay does not change these settings automatically.
Choose the target LAN
Choose an online computer on the same LAN
Pair another computer on the target LAN and keep it online with ClipRelay running. It can send the wake packet while this computer is asleep. Then return here to select it.
The helper could not confirm that it is on this LAN. Check its network and update its ClipRelay host.
Helper saved. Hardware wake has not been verified. Test it after the target sleeps; keep the helper online. Refresh these settings after a network change or within 30 days.
Clear saved helper
The pairing or saved adapter information changed. Reconnect to the computer and configure remote wake again.
Send a wake packet for %1$s using %2$s on %3$s? Hardware and power settings determine whether the computer can wake.
No usable online helper is saved. While the target is online, open Remote wake settings to select an adapter and a paired computer on its LAN. Existing settings expire after 30 days.
Send wake packet
Send from this phone
This sends ordinary Wake-on-LAN packets from the phone using saved addresses. It usually requires the phone to be on the target LAN. Sending a packet does not confirm that the computer woke up.
Sending wake packet…
Wake packet sent. Waiting up to 60 seconds for the paired computer to come online…
The computer has not confirmed it is online. Check power, adapter and BIOS/UEFI settings, and the helper’s network. The packet was sent; wake is still unconfirmed.
Could not confirm packet delivery. A lost reply can occur after sending; check whether the computer appears online before trying again.
The paired computer is online.
